positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsCurrentStandard
positions.frame: What establishes the Pallasine checklist as the legitimate, current onboarding procedure rather than just one option among others?
positions.why: Both expressions read in the same direction: src-1 states the checklist as a mandatory, universal requirement ('Every new hire completes'), and src-2 grounds that mandate historically by naming what it displaced ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter'). Together they perform the checklist's authority as both current rule and legitimate successor to a prior artifact — the relational and power reads (authority-ranking, legitimate/informational) both mark this as one governance move stated in two parts rather than two unrelated facts. No tension to hold; the second expression supports rather than complicates the first.
